messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 38):
"""
The definition of profit margin should be taken as the present value of net profits to the p.v of premiums. Please specify assumptions made in each scenario. For terms less than or equal to one year loss ratio may be used and for terms more than one year, profit margin may be used.] 4.36 Risk discount rate used in the profit margin 4.37 Average Sum Insured Assumed S No Item Particulars (to be filled by the Insurer) 4.38 Assumptions made under pessimistic scenario 4.39 Assumptions made under optimistic scenario 4.40 Age [PM: Profit Margin/Loss Ratio] [Age Band may be revisted based on the product design parameters] PM (base scenario) PM (pessimistic scenario) PM (optimistic scenario) >=0<=2 >=3<=15 >=16<=25 >=26<=30 >=31<=35 >=36<=40 >=41<=45 >=46<=50 >=51<=55 >=56<=60 >=61<=65 >=66 Section IV: Documents to be submitted 25 Documents Submitted: S.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"When should an insurer use the loss ratio instead of the profit margin for calculating profitability?","answer":"An insurer should use the loss ratio for terms less than or equal to one year and use the profit margin for terms more than one year.","facts":["loss ratio may be used","terms less than or equal to one year","profit margin may be used","terms more than one year"]},{"question":"How is the profit margin defined in the IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business?","answer":"The profit margin is defined as the present value of net profits to the present value of premiums.","facts":["definition of profit margin","present value of net profits to the p.v of premiums"]}]}
